steps.speaker: Vex
steps.title: The Mixing Table
steps.body:
Unlike the equipment crafters, we work hands-on here. Drop ingredients into the slots and mix them — the result depends on the combination.

Experiment to discover new recipes. The Chef works the same way with food, if you'd rather start in his kitchen.

steps.speaker: Vex
steps.title: A Word of Caution
steps.body:
You'll want to think before you toss things in the crucible, friend. Old Merta — brilliant woman, steady hands — once mixed three things she swore would make a healing draught.

Took us two days to air out the shop and a week to find all of Merta.
